name: SPECTRUM SBS220CHM 40V Cordless Handy Lawn Mower, 22cm Cutting Width, Brushless Motor, 3 Cutting Heights (30-50mm), Mulching
Body Copy: Mow small lawns, awkward corners, and tight edges around borders with a mower light enough to lift one-handed. At 3.8kg, the Spectrum SBS220CHM is built for spaces a full-size mower won't reach, with a 22cm cutting deck that gets into corners without scalping the turf. A brushless motor spinning at 6,000rpm gives a clean, consistent cut and a longer runtime per charge than a brushed motor would, and shrugs off the maintenance penalty too. Three central cutting heights from 30mm to 50mm let you tune to the season, and the mulching function feeds clippings back to the lawn instead of filling a bag. Folds down flat for shed or cupboard storage. Tool only - pair with any Spectrum 40V battery (2.0Ah or 4.0Ah) and a Spectrum 40V charger, both sold separately. Five-year manufacturer warranty (T&Cs apply).
